observations.detail: Deliberately invalid URL is synchronously rejected with HTTP 500 InvalidParameter.DownloadFailed, not accepted as an asynchronous task.
Wrong project is rejected by ownership lookup with 404 before backend parameter validation; 404 recheck passed.
All three task-query routes use 400 task_not_exist for absent local tasks; rechecks passed. No successful video query was tested.
Supplier and gateway both return full-body HTTP 200 for an out-of-bounds byte range. Same payload hash verified.
Supplier and gateway both return 206 despite mismatched If-Range. Conditional resume semantics are not satisfied; no local correction was added.

unverified: Successful H5 association and real-person upload/deletion: user authentication failed and user declined retry.
Successful video result query/download and nonempty task list: no existing gateway-owned YH video tasks; generation excluded.
Webhook relay and group transfer remain unsupported; rejection paths tested.
